name: Shay Boloor

 "Our belief is that the value of compute per watt will increase over time, not decrease. 

The reason for that, I think it should be obvious to people really, is that as you improve the AI software, as the models get better and better, you get more useful intelligence per watt

text:
There’s this annoying paradox on FinX where everyone wants to follow you when stocks go up but the moment things turn bearish, suddenly everyone’s a hater.

Meanwhile, you’re missing the generational plays.

If you followed @amitisinvesting in 2022, you would’ve heard about $PLTR at $6. Now it’s $192.

If you followed @aleabitoreddit last year, you would’ve heard about $AAOI at $28. It went to $233 in just 6 months.

The trick is that right now is actually when you should be following people and paying attention, not when everything is going up.

Few understand.
